thread:
Maya (Growth): Heads up — planning cohort 'Spark' 3-email mini-series to warm leads before launch webinar. Idea: highlight benchmark teaser, then invite to webinar. We need segments, send windows, and QA.

Jon (Email Ops): Can we do 3 sends over 8 days? Day 0 teaser, day 3 case study, day 7 webinar invite. Use send windows 10-11am local. Batch by timezone buckets. :calendar:

Priya (Content): I have 2 subject line variants per send. Drafts ready in /docs/campaigns/spark. Share for quick edits today.

Ethan (Analytics): Need tracking keys: utm_campaign=spark_cohort, variant=A/B, send_batch_id. Will add cohort filters to GA + attribution. Also propose control group 10%.

Lena (PMM): Segment rules: trial users last 90d w/ >1 session, MQLs in last 30d, uninterested flag excluded. Also add 'no-email-hard-bounce' suppression.

Jon (Email Ops): Deliverability: ramp sends across IP pools. For first wave limit 5k/hr, monitor bounce and spam. @deliverability-bot will run preflight.

deliverability-bot: Preflight complete — SPF/DKIM good, no major spikes. Suggested throttle 4k/hr for new IP.

Maya (Growth): What about benchmark narrative? Need 1 liner for teaser: 'Our new benchmark shows 2–3x inference throughput at 1/2 the cost.' Keep claim tight and link to methodology.

Priya (Content): I can make 2 versions: technical (latency/cost) and customer (faster, cheaper). We'll A/B both in send 1.

Ethan (Analytics): Metric goals: 20% open, 3% click, 1.5% webinar reg. Add tracking for downstream conversion to Dedicated trials.

Samir (Growth Eng): Can we wire up an inbound-routing rule to hand-off webinar signups to SDR queue with source tag `spark_webinar`? I'll add to automation and return a rule ID.

Maya (Growth): Ops checklist: need final send list by Tue EOD. Jon, can you schedule sends? Priya, deliver creatives by tomorrow noon.

Jon (Email Ops): Scheduling ok. I'll create send batches: BATCH_A (Americas), BATCH_B (EMEA), BATCH_C (APAC). API calls: `POST /campaigns/schedule` — payload sample and rate limits in the campaign playbook.

Priya (Content): Creative note: include a short 15s gif of benchmark chart. Also alt-text. cc: Design.

Design: Will export 600x320 mp4 -> gif fallback under 1MB. Will post link shortly.

Legal: Need the benchmark test brief + model/config details. Can't approve '2–3x' without benchmark doc and sample size.

Maya (Growth): Link to benchmark doc: https://redwood.internal/docs/benchmarks/spark-v1 — sharing with legal. Please flag anything that affects messaging.

Ethan (Analytics): I'll wire analytics tags, add the control cohort, and scaffold dashboards for open/click/reg funnels.

Priya (Content): :thumbsup: I'll finish copy and run subject-line test against the control variant by EOD.

Jon (Email Ops): I'll kick off a small seed send tomorrow to internal team + friends & family, track deliverability and inbox placement.

Maya (Growth): Perfect — wrapup: list due Tue EOD, creatives noon Mon, schedule Wed AM. Callout: @deliverability-bot results in thread before full send. Thanks team!
